newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares end weaker in light turnover.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares end weaker in light turnover.

text.p: Chilean blue chips closed softer on Monday in the lightest daily trade so far this year, in the absence of foreign orders due to Wall Street's closure for Presidents Day, said traders.
Volume is seen recovering Tuesday but the bear run is likely to continue with power utilities Chilgener and Endesa seen extending their losing streak, they said.
"We are expecting further adjustments in Endesa and Chilgener as they both rose strongly last week," said on trader.
The 40-share closed down 0.48 percent at 115.2 points.
The general inched down 0.28 percent at 5,329.87 points.
Volume shrank to five billion pesos from 11 billion pesos Friday.
Traders reported the bolsa dragged down by profit-taking by local private investors, with the fall made steeper by the lack of foreign funds.
Losers included pulp-maker Copec, down 1.5 percent at 1,645 pesos, copper products comapny Madeco, down 1.27 percent at 1,165 pesos and power utility Enersis which fell 1.07 percent to 267-1/9 pesos.
Winners included brewery CCU, up 2.32 percent at 1,450 pesos and winery Concha y Toro which rose 2.17 percent to 235 pesos.
